column3: 1) the head with its cheek tufts and cream lower face but WITHOUT EARS (the top of the head is a plain smooth curve; the ears are separate pieces); 2) the left ear; 3) the right ear (each a tall pointed ear with a dark brown rim and cream inside, with a little extra at its base that tucks behind the head); 4) the body with the cream belly and both legs ending at the ankles, without arms, head, tail or feet (the neck top is a simple rounded edge); 5) the left arm and 6) the right arm, each STRAIGHT and hanging down, orange with its dark brown paw; 7) the big bushy tail with the zigzag cream tip; 8) the left foot and 9) the right foot (dark brown)

1) the head: the wide white helmet with its round headphones and the dark navy face screen, the screen EMPTY: no eyes, no mouth, only a soft reflection; WITHOUT the antenna; 2) the antenna (navy stalk with its glowing aqua ball); 3) the body: white torso with the navy shoulder caps, aqua shield badge, navy waistband and both white legs ending at the ankles, without arms, head or boots; 4) the left arm and 5) the right arm, each STRAIGHT and hanging down, white with its navy mitten hand; 6) the left boot and 7) the right boot (navy)

1) the head with its wavy dark brown hair and both ears, with a COMPLETELY BLANK FACE: no eyes, no eyebrows, no nose, no mouth, no blush; 2) the body: the mustard spacesuit with the purple collar ring, backpack straps, star badge, knee pads and both legs ending at the ankles, without arms, head or boots; 3) the left arm and 4) the right arm, each STRAIGHT and hanging down, mustard sleeve with purple cuff and big purple glove; 5) the left boot and 6) the right boot (purple)

1) the whole cloud with its cream face area, its glossy highlights and the little gold star, with a COMPLETELY BLANK FACE: no eyes, no mouth, no blush, and WITHOUT its two puff hands; 2) the left puff hand and 3) the right puff hand (small lilac cloud puffs)

1) the body: the coral paper pentagon with its folded-down cream top-right corner and darker side facets, with a COMPLETELY BLANK FACE: no eyes, no mouth, no blush; without arms and without legs; 2) the left wing-arm and 3) the right wing-arm (flat paper triangles); 4) the left leg and 5) the right leg (trapezoid paper legs)

1) the body: the yellow rounded camera with its viewfinder window, top slot, orange shutter button and the big lens, the lens showing its brown barrel and EMPTY light-blue glass: no pupil, no catchlights, no eye; no mouth, no blush, without arms and without feet; 2) the left arm and 3) the right arm (big dark brown rounded mitts, STRAIGHT, hanging down); 4) the left foot and 5) the right foot (big dark brown shoes on short legs)

1) the head: charcoal with the cream lower face and the cream blaze between the eyes, WITHOUT EARS (plain smooth top), with a COMPLETELY BLANK FACE: no eyes, no glasses, no nose, no mouth, no whiskers, no blush; 2) the left ear and 3) the right ear (pointed, charcoal with pink inside, a little extra at the base); 4) the body: charcoal with the cream belly, legs ending at the ankles, without scarf, arms, head, tail or feet; 5) the left arm and 6) the right arm, each STRAIGHT and hanging down, charcoal with a cream paw; 7) the tail (charcoal, curling, cream tip); 8) the left foot and 9) the right foot (cream paws)

1) the head: the big soft-square linen head with the stitched seam down its left side and the denim patch sewn on its top right corner, with a COMPLETELY BLANK FACE: no eyes, no mouth, no blush; 2) the body: the round denim body with the mustard patch, without arms, head or legs; 3) the left arm and 4) the right arm (soft denim, STRAIGHT, hanging down); 5) the left leg and 6) the right leg (short denim stubs)

1) the head: the domed stone head with the moss on its top, with a COMPLETELY BLANK FACE: no eyes, no mouth, no blush; 2) the body: the stone torso with the amber gem and a little moss, without arms, head or legs; 3) the left arm and 4) the right arm (big blocky stone arms with small hands, STRAIGHT, hanging down); 5) the left leg and 6) the right leg (stubby stone legs)
